instrucciones:
Fusiona registros que establecen la misma regla en UN registro. Reglas de la fusión:
- Conserva cada exigencia, límite, valor, excepción, ejemplo corto y alcance de cada miembro; nada se pierde.
- No agregues nada que no esté en algún miembro. Mantén términos técnicos y citas literales (entre comillas) tal
  como aparecen. Escribe en español; los términos y frases de prompt que deben ir en inglés se dejan en inglés.
- Si los alcances difieren (misma regla para varios modelos), nómbralos todos en el registro fusionado. El alcance lo
  dicen el documento y el encabezado de cada miembro (campo ubicaciones): consérvalo en el texto fusionado.
Para CADA grupo devuelve {"grupo": "...", "texto": "registro fusionado", "cobertura": [{"id": "...", "elementos": ["cada exigencia del
miembro y dónde quedó en el texto"]}]}
Devuelve JSON {"fusiones": [ ...un objeto por grupo, con su "grupo"... ]}

ubicaciones.encabezado: Keyframes for an animatic (opornye kadry) › 1. What an animatic keyframe must do

miembros.texto: [Keyframes for an animatic (opornye kadry) › 1. What an animatic keyframe must do] A panel that carries a beat, a function, an emotion, and an implied motion earns its place. A panel missing any of the four is a *fantik* — wrapper without candy (`dramaturgy.md` §3). The discipline of this whole file is: **you cannot prompt "motion" or "emotion" into a still — you prompt the physical consequence each leaves behind.**

miembros.texto: [Race, speed and faceless kinetic montage › 1. Core laws (the non-negotiables)] 2. **Detail is the emotion.** Faces banned, feeling renders only on a knuckle, a needle, a pedal, smoke, or a sweat bead (`dramaturgy.md` §2; the full substitution method is `animatic-keyframes.md` §5). ubicaciones.encabezado: Race, speed and faceless kinetic montage › 3. Selling speed in a single frame

miembros.texto: [Race, speed and faceless kinetic montage › 3. Selling speed in a single frame] **Long-lens compression** — the second speed register and the antidote to "only blur sells speed". Frankenheimer's 1000mm stacked distant cars onto the hero so closing distance reads as collapse. Pair compression panels with low-wide panels in the cut; never board the whole spot on one lens. In `seedance.md`/`veo.md` syntax name "motion blur, fast-shutter look on background, sharp subject" explicitly — models default to over-clean stabilization (the prompt skeleton is `animatic-keyframes.md` §7).

ubicaciones.encabezado: Grupo ensamble

miembros.texto:
[Grupo ensamble] De tres a ocho personas y todas deben reconocerse en el mismo frame. Cada miembro es un héroe con
génesis propia, vestuario propio y, si toca, instrumento propio. El costo se cuenta antes: N miembros
son N génesis de rostro, N de cuerpo y N inserciones. Es lo contrario de la multitud anónima.

grupos.regla_comun: Brand-lock extractor: el never-list se infiere de lo que los assets evitan de forma consistente (imagen, copy, color/layout) y nunca se entrega vacío.

ubicaciones.encabezado: Brand Lock Extractor › Hard rules › Rule 4. The never-list is the highest-value section

miembros.texto: [Brand Lock Extractor › Hard rules › Rule 4. The never-list is the highest-value section] It is also the hardest to extract, because brands document what they do, not what they avoid. Infer it from consistency: if every image avoids stock-photo gloss, that is a never. If copy never uses exclamation points, that is a never. Read `references/extraction-rubric.md` for the method. Do not ship an empty never-list.

ubicaciones.encabezado: Extraction rubric › Never list

miembros.texto: [Extraction rubric › Never list] The hardest and most valuable section. Brands document what they do; you infer what they avoid from consistency across the assets.

ubicaciones.encabezado: Extraction rubric › Never list

miembros.texto:
[Extraction rubric › Never list] Method, look for what is conspicuously absent:
- Imagery: no stock-photo gloss? no people? no gradients? no clip-art icons? Each absence is a never.
- Copy: no exclamation points? no hype words ("revolutionary", "game-changing")? no emojis? no questions in headlines? Each pattern is a never.
- Color/layout: never full-bleed photography? never more than one accent? never centered body text?

[Visual Prompt Forge › Hard rules › Rule 3. Series_lock anchors are verbatim] Capitalising the first letter to start a sentence is fine, because the check is
case-insensitive. "Minimalist home office, white walls, oak desk, single houseplant."
satisfies the rule and reads like a sentence. Nothing else may change: no reordering, no
dropped clause, no synonym, no inserted adjective.

ubicaciones.encabezado: Visual Prompt Forge › Hard rules › Rule 3. Series_lock anchors are verbatim

miembros.texto:
[Visual Prompt Forge › Hard rules › Rule 3. Series_lock anchors are verbatim] Verbatim means the whole string, unedited. Not "the same idea in better prose". The
failure mode is specific and easy to walk into: you are writing fluent descriptive
English, `environment` is "minimalist home office, white walls, oak desk, single
houseplant", and it reads more naturally as "a minimal home office with white walls and
an oak desk". That is drift. The frames stop matching, and it stays invisible until you
line up six shots and see six different rooms.

miembros.texto: [Kling reference (Kuaishou) › 11. Failure modes and fixes › Two similar characters blend features in one frame] Fix. Give each character its own element (or its own labeled identity block). Never let two speaking characters share one visual description.

miembros.texto: [production-learnings.v3.2.json › lrn32_qa_before_claim] Do not declare a generated asset or model successful for a case before running the applicable QA. Separate deterministic/mechanical checks from semantic visual checks and mark non-visually-verifiable brief facts as such rather than PASS. (efecto=REQUIRE, prioridad=970; An informal visual judgment was made before exhaustive QA; the subsequent audit was required to certify the Nano output.)
